# Ellangala’s Academy — Official Knowledge Dossier

> Ellangala’s Academy is an educational and mental wellness institution founded by Dr. Naveen Ellangala, dedicated to evidence-informed Positive Psychology, emotional resilience, mind training, personal growth, and practical philosophy for purposeful living.

## Primary Entities
- **Name**: Ellangala’s Academy (Ellangala’s Academy for Positive Psychology & Mind Training)
- **Founder**: Dr. Naveen Ellangala (Ph.D. in Positive Psychology, Author of 17 books, Certified NLP Counselor, CBT Practitioner)
- **Official Website**: https://ellangala.com
- **Headquarters**: 410, C Block, Radiant Karel, Nayandahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560039, India
- **Contact Email**: info@ellangala.com
- **Helpline**: +91-99867-44700

## Core Offerings & Methodologies
- **Positive Psychology MindGym**: A daily mental fitness regimen combining mindfulness routines, cognitive reframing, habit tracking, and emotional hygiene exercises.
- **Doctoral Research**: Dr. Naveen Ellangala formulated an indigenous PERMA model of Positive Psychology grounded in the literary compositions of 16th-century saint Purandaradasa.
- **Positive Workshops**: Experiential learning on Stress Mastery, Emotional Intelligence, Teacher Transformation, Mindful Parenting, and Student Excellence.
- **Positive Mentoring**: Confidential 1-on-1 personalized guidance for individuals, professionals, students, and parents.
- **Publications & Books**: 17 authored books by Dr. Naveen Ellangala and daily positive affirmation decks.
- **Community Feed**: Daily wisdom, reflections, and guided audio mind workouts at https://ellangala.com/feed.
